intent.caption: Testimonial panel — A typographic client quote with oversized quotation mark, attribution line, and surface depth.

textContent.text: The bezel action alone is worth the wait. Nothing else on my wrist feels this considered.

visualSpec.effects: Panel 3.4w x 1.9h scene units, corner radius 0.06, albedo vertical engineered gradient #1a1a22 (at 0.0) -> #111116 (at 1.0), 0.006-unit hairline border #26262f, panel roughness 0.6, metalness 0.2, clearcoat 0.1; oversized quotation mark glyph 0.62 units tall in #ff2a38, extruded 0.04 units with roughness 0.5 and metalness 0.3, seated at top-left with 0.5-unit padding (2x base unit) so the key light catches its bowl edge; quote set 0.25 units below the mark on a 0.25-unit baseline grid with max measure 2.4 units; attribution row 0.25 below the quote led by a 0.2w x 0.02h accent rule in #ff2a38 emissive intensity 1.4; quote text floats translateZ +0.03 above the panel plane so raking light gives the letterforms edge definition against the surface; mount fade-up opacity 0 -> 1 and y +0.2 -> 0 over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) for the panel, then the quote mark weighted-settle scale 1.04 -> 1.0 over 900ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1); no idle motion, the piece rests with weight.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Panel fades up once, then the red quotation mark settles with a 1.04 overshoot; everything else is still.
sceneSpec.contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 quote text on panel gradient; 5:1 accent quote mark on panel
